brief:
An analyst known as Doomberg argues that U.S. pressure on central banks to hold Treasury securities is forcing them to divest alternative assets, according to Bitcoin Magazine. This dynamic, Doomberg contends, creates favorable long-term conditions for both gold and Bitcoin as central banks seek alternatives to dollar-denominated holdings.

The reasoning reflects broader concerns among some investors and analysts about the use of financial sanctions and their unintended consequences on global reserve currency demand and central bank asset allocation strategies.
dek: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Doomberg: US Treasury Sanctions are “Wildly Bullish” for Bitcoin & Gold U.S. pressure to hold Treasuries forces central banks to sell what they can, says Doomberg, setting up a wildly bullish long-term case for gold and Bitcoin.
title: Analyst says US Treasury sanctions boost bitcoin and gold outlook
